Since y > z > w > x, I should rank them in that order. This way, if y is obtainable, I get y. If y is not obtainable but z is, I get z, and so on. There's no reason to deviate from my true preferences, as changing the order will only result in me potentially getting a *less* preferred school from my obtainable set. I have high priority at both y and w, so I would expect at least one of them to be in my obtainable set.
